extension.description: Founder-approved tester packages. Install Shadow from this repository to establish its update origin. Installation is independent of future licence activation.

Personal Kodi 21 development build for approved live channels, Movies and TV Series. Credential-isolating revocable local playback relay; verified HTTPS or explicitly approved HTTP connection choices. Account-scoped Watch Later, resume history, watched controls, tolerant local search, recently discovered titles and personal backup/restore. Provider programme guide, Now/Next progress, public artwork and overview fallbacks. Optional next-episode prompts and cancellable autoplay, disabled by default. Optional unencrypted local login storage and remembered connection permissions. Synthetic local playback tests included. Native Xbox acceptance remains required.
